headline.title: Apple to pay $250M to settle lawsuit over Siri’s delayed AI features
headline.summary: Apple has reached a $250 million settlement in a class action lawsuit concerning claims that it overpromised the release of AI features for Siri. The settlement addresses allegations that the company misled consumers about the capabilities and timeline of its virtual assistant.

articles.title: 5 gardening tips you can try right in Search
articles.summary: The article provides five practical gardening tips that users can easily implement through search queries. These tips aim to enhance gardening practices by leveraging online resources and information.

articles.title: Snap says its $400M deal with Perplexity ‘amicably ended’
articles.summary: Snap has announced that its $400 million deal with Perplexity, aimed at integrating the AI search engine into Snapchat, has ended amicably. The partnership was initially announced in November 2022.

articles.title: Musk’s biggest loyalist became his biggest liability
articles.summary: Shivon Zilis, a key figure in Elon Musk's ventures and the mother of four of his children, testified in the Musk v. Altman trial, raising questions about her role and decisions. Her testimony highlighted the complexities of her relationship with Musk amid ongoing legal disputes.

articles.title: Five architects of the AI economy explain where the wheels are coming off
articles.summary: At the Milken Global Conference, five key figures in the AI supply chain discussed challenges such as chip shortages and the potential flaws in the current technological architecture. Their insights highlight critical issues affecting the development and deployment of AI technologies.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s Last-Ditch Effort to Control OpenAI: Recruit Sam Altman to Tesla
articles.summary: Elon Musk attempted to exert control over OpenAI by considering the recruitment of CEO Sam Altman to lead a rival AI lab at Tesla in 2017. Internal communications among Tesla executives and Shivon Zilis indicate plans to establish this competing initiative, potentially involving other AI leaders like Demis Hassabis.

articles.title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks
articles.summary: Pro$^2$Assist is a new system designed to provide continuous, proactive assistance for long-horizon procedural tasks by utilizing multimodal egocentric perception. Unlike existing personal assistants that primarily offer reactive support, Pro$^2$Assist aims to enhance user experience by anticipating needs throughout complex, multi-step activities.

articles.title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents
articles.summary: A new study evaluates a coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 that employs an executable Python world model, which is verified against past observations and refactored for simplicity. The system utilizes a scripted controller and predefined interfaces to plan actions based on the model before execution.

articles.title: A Regulatory Governance Framework for AI-Driven Financial Fraud Detection in U.S. Banking: Integrating OCC, SR 11-7, CFPB, and FinCEN Compliance Requirements for Model Development, Validation, and Monitoring Lifecycles
articles.summary: The article proposes a Regulatory Governance Framework to address the fragmented compliance landscape faced by U.S. financial institutions using AI for fraud detection. It integrates requirements from the OCC, SR 11-7, CFPB, and FinCEN to enhance model development, validation, and monitoring practices.

articles.title: Resilient AI Supercomputer Networking using MRC and SRv6
articles.summary: The article presents a new approach to enhance the performance of synchronous pretraining jobs on large-scale AI supercomputers by addressing tail latency issues. It introduces a novel RDMA-based transport protocol called MRC, which utilizes multiple paths for load balancing, alongside multi-plane Clos topologies to improve redundancy and efficiency in training clusters exceeding 100,000 GPUs.

articles.title: StableI2I: Spotting Unintended Changes in Image-to-Image Transition
articles.summary: StableI2I is a new evaluation framework designed to assess image-to-image (I2I) transitions by measuring semantic correspondence and spatial structure preservation in generated images. This approach addresses the limitations of existing evaluations that primarily focus on instruction adherence and aesthetic quality.

articles.title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting
articles.summary: Ilov3Splat is a new framework designed for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding, utilizing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) to enhance cross-view consistency and coherent instance-level reasoning. This approach improves precision in downstream 3D tasks by jointly optimizing scene geometry and semantics, overcoming limitations of previous methods that relied on 2D rendering and point-level associations.
